summary: YPF Sociedad Anónima filed a Form 6-K reporting its completion of an open-market share repurchase program. Between June 8 and June 12, 2026, the company acquired 461,311 of its Class D ordinary shares on ByMA at an average price of Ps. 83,321.2504 per share, totaling Ps. 38,437,009,350. The acquisitions complied with a daily limit of 25% of average daily trading volume over the preceding 90 days. The buyback was authorized by the Board of Directors. No advisors or terms for a formal offer are disclosed. What to watch: as the program is completed, no further near-term buyback activity is expected; the market may view this as a signal of capital allocation commitment.
